##: Scoop manifest template. The package-manifests workflow fills in the version and the SHA-256 of the portable zip after a release is published; the result can go to a bucket (e.g. ScoopInstaller/Extras) by hand. See docs/PACKAGING.md.
description: A beautiful, stable, cross-platform BitTorrent client
notes: Corrent runs in portable mode here: its data lives in $persist_dir\corrent-data. Settings > General > 'Open with Corrent' registers it for magnet links and .torrent files.
